# Booking UI Requirements Quality Checklist: Customer Booking Interface

**Purpose**: Validate the quality of the UX, accessibility, error-recovery and secret-handling requirements for the customer booking and cancellation interface (standard depth, PR/spec reviewer audience)
**Created**: 2026-11-12
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [contracts/messages.md](../contracts/messages.md) · [contracts/ui-routes.md](../contracts/ui-routes.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the exact reasons for an empty day enumerated in the spec itself, rather than only by reference to the backend's published API description? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, Assumptions]
- [x] CHK002 Is the "outside service hours when applicable" reason given a defined applicability condition? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK003 Are requirements defined for what the customer sees when the period list is returned but every period is empty versus when the server reports a reason? [Coverage, Spec §FR-002, §FR-004]
- [x] CHK004 Are requirements defined for how the "service not available" screen behaves when the configuration is valid but the server address is wrong (as opposed to missing/invalid)? [Gap, Spec §FR-030]
- [x] CHK005 Is the page title/heading content required on each screen, given that only "a simple title" is mentioned? [Gap, Assumptions]
- [x] CHK006 Are requirements specified for the customer's next step after a "cannot be cancelled" or "not found" outcome beyond the link to the booking page? [Completeness, Spec §FR-018, §FR-021]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK007 Is "plain words" defined with criteria (reading level, length, no jargon) so that message wording can be judged objectively? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-007, §FR-013, §FR-028]
- [x] CHK008 Is "in an unambiguous format" for dates specified in the spec, or only in the routes contract? [Clarity, Spec §FR-029, Contract ui-routes "Display formats"]
- [x] CHK009 Is "sufficient contrast for normal text" quantified in the spec rather than only in the contract (4.5:1)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-026]
- [x] CHK010 Is "normal conditions" for the 2-second refresh target defined (network, server load, device)? [Ambiguity, Spec §SC-002]
- [x] CHK011 Is "deliberate selection" of a time defined precisely enough to distinguish it from an accidental one? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK012 Is the way "sufficient" focus movement is judged specified (which element receives focus on each step change)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-025]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK013 Do the date rules agree: the spec says past dates cannot be picked and the date control uses the visitor's clock, while the routes contract says the visitor's clock is "used for no rule"? [Conflict, Spec §Edge Cases "Dates", Assumptions, Contract ui-routes]
- [x] CHK014 Is the phone rule consistent between the spec ("7–20 characters… at least 7 digits") and the field message ("7 to 20 digits")? [Conflict, Spec §FR-007, Contract messages "Field problems"]
- [x] CHK015 Is the unknown-outcome wording on a lost create answer consistent between the edge case, FR-014 and the "Unreachable (create)" message? [Consistency, Spec §FR-014, Contract messages]
- [x] CHK016 Are the "server error on create" requirements consistent between the edge case (check email, not blamed for validation) and FR-013 ("way to retry")? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-013]
- [x] CHK017 Does the "too soon" next step ("contact the restaurant") align with the spec's statement that no contact details are shown in this feature? [Consistency, Contract messages, Assumptions]
- [x] CHK018 Is the cancellation-code handling in the spec (cleared after final outcome) consistent with the retry of a temporary failure, which needs the code to remain? [Consistency, Spec §FR-020, §FR-017, Contract messages "Server error / unreachable (cancel)"]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK019 Can SC-001 ("under 2 minutes, 9 of 10 runs") be evaluated given that participants, device and test protocol are not defined? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK020 Is the 10-second unreachable threshold in SC-009 reflected as a requirement in the functional requirements (timeout behaviour)? [Gap, Spec §SC-009, §FR-027]
- [x] CHK021 Are "serious or critical violations" tied to a named standard and level (e.g. a WCAG version and level)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-007]
- [x] CHK022 Is the set of "every screen and state" for SC-006 and SC-007 enumerated and traceable to the screens table? [Traceability, Spec §SC-006, §SC-007, Contract ui-routes]

## Scenario & Exception Coverage

- [x] CHK023 Are requirements defined for a server answer that arrives after the customer has navigated to the other destination? [Gap, Coverage]
- [x] CHK024 Are requirements defined for the customer changing the date or party size while the details form is being submitted? [Gap, Spec §FR-003, §FR-010]
- [x] CHK025 Are recovery requirements defined for a failed times refresh after a "no longer available" refusal (the refresh itself fails or is unreachable)? [Gap, Spec §FR-011, §FR-027]
- [x] CHK026 Is the behaviour defined for a `VALIDATION_ERROR` that names a field the form does not show? [Coverage, Contract messages "VALIDATION_ERROR"]
- [x] CHK027 Are requirements defined for cancel when the server answers success but with missing reservation details? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-018]
- [x] CHK028 Is the intended behaviour specified for the browser Back button from the cancellation outcome and from the manual-code state? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases "Browser back/forward"]

## Secret Handling & Privacy

- [x] CHK029 Is "kept only in memory" defined for the case where a browser extension, error reporter or devtools log captures state? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-009, §FR-016]
- [x] CHK030 Are referrer and history-entry leakage of the cancellation fragment addressed as requirements in the spec, not only as an implementation note in the contract? [Gap, Spec §FR-016, Contract ui-routes]
- [x] CHK031 Is the requirement that the duplicate-email message reveals nothing about the existing reservation measurable (what exactly must not appear)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK032 Are personal details (name, email, phone) covered by an explicit no-storage/no-logging requirement comparable to the one for the secret code? [Gap, Spec §FR-009, §FR-015]

## Non-Functional (Accessibility, Responsiveness)

- [x] CHK033 Are touch-target size and visible-focus requirements stated in the spec, or only in the routes contract? [Gap, Spec §FR-024–FR-026, Contract ui-routes]
- [x] CHK034 Are requirements defined for text resizing/zoom (e.g. 200 %) and for displays wider than desktop? [Gap, Spec §FR-024]
- [x] CHK035 Are announcement requirements specified for each status change (politeness level, wording source), or only that they are "announced"? [Clarity, Spec §FR-026]
- [x] CHK036 Are reduced-motion and high-contrast preferences covered by the spec requirements? [Gap, Spec §FR-026]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK037 Is the assumption that the backend's reason and error sets are closed validated against a stated contract version? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK038 Is the dependency on the backend's configured cancellation link base matching the cancellation path recorded as a release requirement? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions, Contract ui-routes]
- [x] CHK039 Is the supported-browser statement ("current versions of the major ones") specific enough to decide what is in or out of scope? [Ambiguity, Spec §Assumptions]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Likely real findings to resolve first: CHK013, CHK014, CHK017, CHK018
